note: P is one poem four times: every piece leans on 'nacreous' and 'mother-of-pearl', twilight/dawn light, the sky 'holding' something, with near-identical phrasing. Q varies subject and moment (cold hands catching colour, a palm shading the sun, post-storm sky held in hands, dusk fading to grey), though Q1 and Q4 share the draining-colour ending and Q3 is not clearly about rare clouds.
